REGIONAL YOUTH ACTION PROGRAMME Next month, students from four partner schools will join a three-day Regional Youth Action Programme. Its purpose is to help young people learn how small community projects are planned and carried out. (13) ______. Before the programme starts, participants will receive short descriptions of two local community needs. Each student will also think about one skill or experience they can contribute. (14) ______. On the first day, mixed teams will meet local organisers and discuss possible activities. Each team session will involve (15) ______ a simple plan that can be completed during the visit. The following day, teams will carry out one short activity and then review what worked well and what could be improved. (16) ______. By the end of the programme, students should understand that effective community work depends not only on having good ideas but also on (17) ______ with others and responding to local needs. Question 13.A. Students will therefore spend all three days listening to talks at school.B. For this reason, the programme combines short training sessions with direct community work.C. The organisers have decided that participants should work separately during the visit.D. As a result, no preparation will be needed before students begin the programme.Write A, B, C, or D - {#1} Question 14.A. The organisers will use these notes to remove all team activities.B. Students will not discuss these ideas again during the programme.C. This preparation will give the teams useful starting points when they first meet.D. The programme therefore expects everyone to arrive with identical experience.Write A, B, C, or D - {#2} Question 15.A. prepareB. preparingC. preparedD. to preparingWrite A, B, C, or D - {#3} Question 16.A. This review will help students connect their practical experience with what they learned in training.B. The review will ensure that every team receives exactly the same result.C. After the activity, students will no longer need to discuss what happened.D. The organisers will use the review only to choose a winning team.Write A, B, C, or D - {#4} Question 17.A. cooperatingB. cooperateC. cooperatedD. to cooperateWrite A, B, C, or D - {#5}
